name: Ring of Voluntary Experimental Research
description:
This ring may be imbued with a single charge of any Arcanist spell which they do not know but for which they have any prerequisites. Imbuing it takes one hour and must be done in the presence of a written copy of the spell.

When the spell is discharged, a set of scrolls and a quill appear before the caster. The scrolls must be filled out in triplicate, explaining the effects of the spell, why the wearer wishes to cast it, whether it is for business or pleasure, and so on. This process takes five minutes for every 1 MP the spell costs to cast.

Upon completion, the scrolls and quill disappear, and the spell may be cast immediately or within the next minute, otherwise the charge is returned to the ring and the paperwork must be completed again before the spell can be cast.
